features.title: A sofa that adapts to your needs
features.text: The Highrolla is designed for versatility, offering modular configurations that let you adjust its layout to suit your space or seating preferences.

features.title: Luxurious velvet fabric for everyday comfort
features.text: Upholstered in soft, 100% polyester velvet fabric, this sofa feels as good as it looks, adding a cosy and elegant touch to your living space.

features.title: Back support that hugs you just right
features.text: Elastic bands in the back frame ensure proper lumbar support, creating a snug, sink-in experience every time you sit.

features.title: Built to last with sturdy construction
features.text: Made using pinewood and MDF, this sofa is built to withstand everyday use while maintaining its polished look and moisture resistant structure.

features.title: Designed for a bouncy feel and added comfort
features.text: Incorporates an S spring suspension system in the base frame, providing a comfortable and bouncy seating experience.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
